# UX Checklist: Meeting Dashboard Review

**Purpose**: Validate UX, accessibility, localization, and clean-room requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the primary meeting list controls specified: search, filters, sorting, opening a meeting, and safe disabled future actions? [Completeness, Spec FR-014/FR-017]
- [x] CHK002 Are the meeting detail information-architecture requirements explicit enough for `Notes` and `Recording & Transcript` without inventing generated content? [Clarity, Spec FR-018]
- [x] CHK003 Are speaker labels, uncertainty, timestamps, and correction entry points specified without requiring full contact assignment workflows in 016? [Completeness, Spec FR-020]
- [x] CHK004 Are processing, partial, blocked, failed, local-only, and unavailable states specified as first-class user-visible states? [Coverage, Spec US3, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Are stable future locations specified for share, export, download, retention, deletion, assistant, templates, tags, saved/starred state, and collaboration/access slots? [Completeness, Spec FR-008/FR-017/FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the browser-owned post-meeting surface boundary clear enough to avoid duplicating product review UI inside native desktop code? [Clarity, Spec Product Scope Boundary, FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is the native desktop capture boundary clear enough to prevent server-rendered UI from owning active recording, Stop, device, or permission states? [Clarity, Spec FR-011/FR-021]
- [x] CHK008 Are Russian localization, keyboard focus, accessible names, contrast, non-color status cues, and no-overflow expectations explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec FR-015, SC-007]
- [x] CHK009 Are V8 mockups treated as an implementation baseline while allowing documented deviations from live Krisp/Krisp evidence? [Consistency, Spec FR-012/FR-013]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK010 Can list-to-detail readiness be measured without operator tooling? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK011 Can responsive embedded/browser quality be judged against text overlap, clipped controls, keyboard access, and color-only status criteria? [Measurability, Spec SC-007]
- [x] CHK012 Does final evidence coverage include V8, live Krisp/Krisp web, desktop references, and implemented 2brain Rec surfaces without requiring private artifacts in git? [Evidence, Spec SC-008]

## Notes

- UX checklist passes after V8 handoff and live reference review were linked into the audit.
